item.gscraft.metal_scrap.tip: Hardware. Frames, tools, casings: six make a steel frame.
item.gscraft.duct_tape.tip: Hardware. Holds a wiring harness together.
item.gscraft.silicone_tube.tip: Mechanical. A welding torch wants two.
item.gscraft.corrugated_hose.tip: Mechanical. A filter cartridge wants one.
item.gscraft.wire_spool.tip: Electrical. Three make a wiring harness with a cord and tape.
item.gscraft.capacitor.tip: Electrical. A circuit assembly wants two.
item.gscraft.circuit_board.tip: Electrical. The heart of a circuit assembly.
item.gscraft.relay.tip: Electrical. A circuit assembly wants one.
item.gscraft.light_bulb.tip: Electrical. Michael wants one to light the compound.
item.gscraft.hard_drive.tip: Electrical. Office salvage; Tune reads them.
item.gscraft.broken_radio.tip: Valuables. Tune can make a map of it.
item.gscraft.water_filter.tip: Filters. A filter cartridge starts here.
item.gscraft.painkillers.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one blister.
item.gscraft.antiseptic.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one.
item.gscraft.syringe.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one.
item.gscraft.canned_goods.tip: Food. Apartments are full of it.
item.gscraft.cloth.tip: Two wool or four string at any station; sandbags and storage want it.
item.gscraft.damaged_pistol.tip: Salvage. The salvaging table takes it apart.
item.gscraft.wrench.tip: Tool. Walker's first gift; three metal scrap at a station.
item.gscraft.welding_torch.tip: Tool. A steel frame is welded; sits in the station's tool slot.
item.gscraft.fastener_kit.tip: 4 bolts, 4 nuts, 4 screws, 4 nails; two minutes at a station.
item.gscraft.steel_frame.tip: 6 metal scrap and a fastener kit, welded; two minutes.
item.gscraft.wiring_harness.tip: 3 wire spools, a power cord, duct tape; two minutes.
item.gscraft.filter_cartridge.tip: A water filter, a corrugated hose, bleach; two minutes.
item.gscraft.circuit_assembly.tip: A circuit board, 2 capacitors, a relay, a wire spool; two minutes.
item.gscraft.med_kit.tip: 2 bandages, painkillers, antiseptic, a syringe; two minutes. Heals a wound.
item.gscraft.casings.tip: 2 metal scrap make 16, quick, at a station.
item.gscraft.powder.tip: Gunpowder and solvent make 4, quick, at a station.
item.gscraft.concrete_mix.tip: 4 gravel, 4 sand, a bucket of water make 8, quick; walls and stations want it.

gscraft.say.tune.join_1: You're up. Six of us out here — the gate's west, on the bridge.
gscraft.say.tune.join_2: Walker's in the hall. He'll want bolts before he wants your name.
gscraft.say.tune.join_3: Night's ten minutes off. Stay inside the torches till you've a gun that works.
gscraft.say.tune.map: Press M for the map. Middle-mouse pings a spot for everyone.
gscraft.say.walker.hello: Bring me anything with a thread on it. Bolts, nuts — the town's full of them.
gscraft.say.tony.hello: Bandages first, and painkillers if you find any. The shelves here are bare.
gscraft.say.michael.hello: Wire. Spools of it, and a cord that still bends. Then we get lights.
gscraft.say.tune.hello: Boards, capacitors, and a radio somebody dropped. I can hear the town from here.
gscraft.say.james.hello: The station and the crossing. Walk them and I'll put them on your map.
gscraft.say.marshall.hello: Close that corner first. Sandbags — then we talk.
gscraft.say.walker.station: Good. Set your station down somewhere inside the wire. It'll only ever answer to you.
gscraft.say.michael.lights: There. Now we can see what's coming.
gscraft.say.marshall.speaks: We're squatting in someone's town. Clear it and it's ours. Start north — there's a hospital up that road. Ask James what's in it first.
gscraft.say.marshall.marker_set: Marker's in. Five minutes — hold it, and stay inside.
gscraft.say.marshall.marker_refused: James hasn't been. Neither have you.
gscraft.say.marshall.nobody: That's nobody's ground. The marker goes down at a strongpoint.
gscraft.say.marshall.assault_lost: The marker's down. Craft another and we go again.
